feeds.title: Penn Dixie Fossil Park & Nature Reserve Blog
feeds.description: We promote the hands-on study of natural sciences, including geology, astronomy, and ecology through the operation of the Penn Dixie Fossil Park and Nature Preserve. Penn Dixie offers a unique outdoor educational experience. We are passionate about collecting fossils and sharing information about them.

feeds.title: Louisville Fossils
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Kentuckiana Mike. This is a blog about fossils. In particular, the remains of invertebrate marine creatures from the Ordovician, Silurian, Devonian, and Mississippian time periods. Originally I posted fossils from my local area but now as my travels and contacts expand I post fossils from all over the world.

feeds.title: The Fossil Shop Blog » Fossil
feeds.description: Get fossil hunting tips and details about different fossils that keep coming at our shop all in our blog. All of our fossils are legally and ethically sourced, either by ourselves or from trusted suppliers. We have a great range of local, Yorkshire Coast fossils as well as other UK material and fossils from around the World. We also conduct educational events in school for students to know what exactly fossils are!

feeds.title: Everything Dinosaur Blog
feeds.description: A fantastic blog about dinosaur models and everything else to do with dinosaurs including new discoveries, new models, and more. The aim of the blog is to provide open access to news about paleontology, research into dinosaurs, and updates on fossil discoveries. Everything Dinosaur specializes in the supply of dinosaur and prehistoric animal-related toys, models, books, posters, clothing, and other dinosaur-themed merchandise.

feeds.title: Fossil Crates Blogs
feeds.description: Your source for the latest in paleontology and dinosaur discoveries by renowned dinosaur paleontologist and sauropod expert Dr. Brian Curtice! We also provide Museum-quality casts of dinosaur teeth, claws, skulls, and more accompanied by exclusive paleoart and up-to-date info about these awesome creatures from actual dinosaur paleontologists.

feeds.title: Palaeontologia Electronica
feeds.description: Get all updates about the newly discovered fossils and also in-depth information about them. Founded in 1997, Palaeontologia Electronica is the longest-running open-access, peer-reviewed electronic journal and covers all aspects of paleontology.

feeds.title: Kristina Barclay » Fossil Fridays
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Kristina Barclay. Exploring the past, present, and future of marine ecosystems and sharing everything through my blog so that even you can take a deep dive with me and know more about marine fossils. An important aspect of my research is using fossil data to trace ecosystem changes through time as a means of aiding modern conservation efforts and climate change research.

feeds.title: West Coast Fossil Park Blog
feeds.description: In our blog, we share information about the fascinating and unique history of fossils from the West Coast Fossil Park. Our main goal is to educate children about fossils and make an attempt to recreate the environment and climate of the west coast.
